dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-intensity rings are distributed across the lateral neck. The most prominent features exhibit thin, high-contrast perimeters with sharp transitions from the dark fur background to light-grey line work.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, localized high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily visible in the lower-lateral neck region as solid light-grey flecks.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent macro-annuli on the mid-lateral surface form an obtuse scalene triangle, with two smaller satellite annuli forming a linear chain dorsal to the primary group.

other_distinctive_markers: Three parallel, longitudinal high-intensity streaks are visible in the sub-orbital region, distinct from the primary annular patterns.
